visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation of a white and yellow cat character wearing a chicken-shaped headpiece and a white spacesuit standing against a plain white background. The cat has a neutral expression and large eyes. (2) The scene cuts to the same cat wearing a yellow banana costume with the stem on top. The cat's eyes are half-closed, giving it a bored or sleepy expression. (3) The video cuts rapidly between the cat in the chicken suit and the cat in the banana suit, matching a rhythmic audio cue. (4) The banana-cat is shown from behind, revealing its yellow tail and the back of the banana peel costume. (5) Multiple banana-cat variations appear in a vertical stack, featuring different fur colors (grey, orange tabby) and slightly different bored facial expressions. (6) The cat in the chicken suit begins dancing, moving its paws up and down. (7) The banana-cat and chicken-cat are shown side-by-side dancing in sync, shaking their bodies and waving their small paws. (8) More copies of the cats appear on screen in a mirrored or grouped layout, all dancing to the rhythm of the track until the video ends.

(2) A quick percussive fill leads into the voice saying 'Banana'. The pitch of the vocal delivery is slightly lower than 'Chicken', creating a rhythmic contrast. (3) The pattern repeats: 'Chicken' followed by 'Banana', with the instrumental layers maintaining a steady, high-energy dance tempo. (4) The audio editing becomes more rapid, repeating 'Banana' several times in quick succession. The spectral brightness remains consistent throughout, indicating professional studio production with a focus on catchy, meme-oriented audio design.
